 R=np.array([[np.cos(heading),-np.sin(heading)],[np.sin(heading),np.cos(heading)]])
 cur=c.feet.copy()
 for k in range(nsteps):
  swing=k%2;stance=1-swing
  beg=int(round((start+k*period)/dt));end=int(round((start+(k+1)*period-ds)/dt));stop=int(round((start+(k+1)*period)/dt))
  if stop>=T:break
  goal=cur[swing].copy();goal[:2]=R@np.array([step_length*(k+1),width*(.5 if swing==0 else -.5)])
  for t in range(beg,end):
   u=(t-beg)/(end-beg);blend=u**3*(10+u*(-15+6*u))
   feet[t,swing]=cur[swing]+blend*(goal-cur[swing]);feet[t,swing,2]+=height*np.sin(np.pi*u)**2
   support[t,swing]=False
  feet[end:,swing]=goal
  zmp[beg:end,:2]=cur[stance,:2]+R@np.array([.025,0])
  for t in range(end,stop):
   u=(t-end)/(stop-end);zmp[t,:2]=(1-u)*cur[stance,:2]+u*goal[:2]+R@np.array([.025,0])
  cur[swing]=goal
  zmp[stop:,:2]=cur[:, :2].mean(axis=0)+R@np.array([.025,0])

def footsteps(waypoints,length=.28,turn=.25):
 steps=[];xy=np.zeros(2);yaw=0.
 for wp in waypoints:
  goal=np.array(wp[:2]);gy=wp[2]
  count=max(1,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(goal-xy)/length)),int(np.ceil(abs(gy-yaw)/turn)))
  for k in range(count):
   u=(k+1)/count;steps.append(np.r_[xy+u*(goal-xy),yaw+u*(gy-yaw)])
  xy=goal;yaw=gy
 return np.array(steps)

def plan(c,steps,period=.6,ds=.15,height=.1,width=.4,start=.8):
 dt=.02;T=1000;feet=np.tile(c.feet,(T,1,1));support=np.ones((T,2),bool);zmp=np.tile(c.com0,(T,1));yaw=np.zeros(T);footyaw=np.zeros((T,2))
 cur=c.feet.copy();curyaw=np.zeros(2);oldyaw=0
 for k,step in enumerate(steps):
  swing=k%2;stance=1-swing;x,y,angle=step;R=np.array([[np.cos(angle),-np.sin(angle)],[np.sin(angle),np.cos(angle)]])
  beg=int(round((start+k*period)/dt));end=int(round((start+(k+1)*period-ds)/dt));stop=int(round((start+(k+1)*period)/dt))
  if stop>=T:break
  goal=cur[swing].copy();goal[:2]=np.array([x,y])+R@np.array([0,width*(.5 if swing==0 else -.5)])
  for t in range(beg,end):
   u=(t-beg)/(end-beg);blend=u**3*(10+u*(-15+6*u))
   feet[t,swing]=cur[swing]+blend*(goal-cur[swing]);feet[t,swing,2]+=height*np.sin(np.pi*u)**2
   footyaw[t,swing]=curyaw[swing]+blend*(angle-curyaw[swing]);support[t,swing]=False
  feet[end:,swing]=goal;footyaw[end:,swing]=angle
  offset=.025*np.array([np.cos(curyaw[stance]),np.sin(curyaw[stance])])
  zmp[beg:end,:2]=cur[stance,:2]+offset
  for t in range(end,stop):
   u=(t-end)/(stop-end);zmp[t,:2]=(1-u)*(cur[stance,:2]+offset)+u*(goal[:2]+R@np.array([.025,0]))
  for t in range(beg,stop):
   u=(t-beg)/(stop-beg);yaw[t]=oldyaw+u*(angle-oldyaw)
  yaw[stop:]=angle;oldyaw=angle
  cur[swing]=goal;curyaw[swing]=angle
  zmp[stop:,:2]=cur[:, :2].mean(axis=0)+R@np.array([.025,0])
  if k==0:
   for t in range(beg):

 omega=np.sqrt(9.81/c.com0[2]);tt=np.arange(-250,251)*dt;kernel=np.exp(-omega*abs(tt));kernel/=kernel.sum()
 com=zmp.copy();com[:,:2]=convolve1d(zmp[:,:2],kernel,axis=0,mode='nearest');com[:,2]=c.com0[2]
 cv=np.gradient(com,dt,axis=0);ca=np.gradient(cv,dt,axis=0)
 fv=np.gradient(feet,dt,axis=0);fa=np.gradient(fv,dt,axis=0)
 return dict(com=com,comvel=cv,comacc=ca,feet=feet,feetvel=fv,feetacc=fa,support=support,yaw=yaw,footyaw=footyaw)

def run(steps=None,params=None,save='/app/output/route_test.npz',quiet=False):
